title: UV Index and Sun-Safety Advisory
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers.
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecowitt:obs
| stats max(uv_index) as peak_uv, latest(_time) as when by date_mday
| eval advice=case(peak_uv>=8,"extreme - cover up",peak_uv>=6,"high - sunscreen",peak_uv>=3,"moderate",1=1,"low")
| sort - when
description: Records the peak ultraviolet index each day from your weather station and turns it into simple sun-safety advice for the family.
value: Local ultraviolet readings help you plan outdoor time and remember sunscreen, especially for children and fair skin.
implementation: Ingest weather-station ultraviolet readings; schedule daily and surface the peak with plain-language advice.
visualization: Column chart of daily peak ultraviolet index with advisory bands.
grandmaExplanation: It records how strong the sun was each day and reminds you when to wear sunscreen or stay in the shade.
